subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should `ChannelMessageActionAdapter.normalizeMessageActionRequest` and the globally named `send-location` action become supported permanent Plugin SDK contracts for channel-owned request repair?
rationale: The branch intentionally expands public plugin and action surfaces; source validation can establish mechanics, but only an owner can choose the durable extension boundary and compatibility commitment.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Accept the generic normalization hook and shared action name, then require final-head Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the repair Telegram-private
options.body: Ask for a narrower design that repairs model-authored Telegram sends without publishing a reusable cross-plugin normalization hook.

options.title: Defer the API expansion
options.body: Pause this PR until the plugin SDK direction is settled, preserving the existing strict mixed-payload behavior in the meantime.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Accept the generic normalization hook and shared action name, then require final-head Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available record identifies the author of the proposed API boundary, but a repository owner should make the final product-contract decision.
